definitions.gloss: not a drop, not even a little
definitions.explanation: Used with negation to emphasize complete absence of something.

examples.japanese: {一滴|いってき}の{水|みず}も{無駄|むだ}にしない。
examples.english: I don't waste even a single drop of water.

examples.japanese: インクを{一滴|いってき}たらした。
examples.english: I dropped one drop of ink.

examples.japanese: {目薬|めぐすり}を{一滴|いってき}さす。
examples.english: I apply one drop of eye drops.

examples.japanese: {酒|さけ}は{一滴|いってき}も{飲|の}まない。
examples.english: I don't drink a single drop of alcohol.

examples.japanese: {涙|なみだ}{一滴|いってき}{見|み}せなかった。
examples.english: He didn't show a single tear.

examples.japanese: {血|ち}の{一滴|いってき}まで{絞|しぼ}り{取|と}る。
examples.english: To squeeze out every last drop of blood.

notes:
{一滴|いってき} refers to a single drop of liquid.

LITERAL USAGE (Sense 1):
- {目薬|めぐすり}を{一滴|いってき}: one drop of eye drops
- {水|みず}{一滴|いってき}: one drop of water
- {血|ち}の{一滴|いってき}: one drop of blood

EMPHATIC NEGATIVE (Sense 2):
- {一滴|いってき}も〜ない: not even a drop
- Emphasizes complete absence or abstinence
- Often used with {酒|さけ} (alcohol)

RELATED WORDS:
- {二滴|にてき}: two drops
- {数滴|すうてき}: several drops
- {点滴|てんてき}: IV drip (medical)
